notes.title: 2022-02-14 Update
notes.content:
Updated 2/14/2022

After being evaded many times, increase the probability of the protagonist's hit (The same move cannot be used a second time on Saint Seiya)
Be

Be
Adjust the duration of some skills:
Healing: Regenerates 3 health per second for 4 seconds (regenerates 5 health per second for 2 seconds)
Vampire: Generates 10 stacks of lifesteal buffs for 6 seconds (generates 30 stacks of bloodsteal buffs for 3 seconds)
